## About (written by a human)

This entire application, including most of this README  was generated by Claude Code with the exception of the icon which was initially done by ChatGPT and then I had Claude jack with it because ChatGPT did a shit job.

I haven't looked at the code, I'm not a flutter developer and even if I was, I don't care. I'm moving my tablet to LineageOS (sans Google bullshit) and the options for comic book reader on F-Droid aren't great so I spent a Saturday telling Claude what to do and ta-da Multiversal. The code may be shit, it's not particularly fast and it doesn't support anything but CBZ but it works for my use case and that's what software is about, solving problems.

Am I going to put this on app stores? No. Can you? You do you, superstar, I'm not here to tell you how to live. Am I going to add functionality? Probably not. I've already converted all my shit to CBZ and babysat my devices while SyncThing ran for 14 years to update. Unless something is broken that I haven't run into yet, this is probably where it's at.

Regarding the lack of support for CB[R|7] or other formats, there's a script in `tools/cbr_to_cbz.py` that will convert your CBRs to CBZs (assuming you have `unrar` installed). It will also convert your CBRs to CB7s because Claude & I were thinking about supporting CB7 for a while but it didn't pan out.

## Key Features

- **CBZ Support**: Optimized reading of ZIP-based comic books
- **Full-Screen Viewer**: Immersive reading experience with gesture controls
- **Smart Navigation**: Tap zones, swipe gestures, and progress slider
- **Pinch-to-Zoom**: Fully functional zoom with pan support
- **Hidden Files Filter**: Option to hide/show files and folders starting with '.'
- **Read Status Tracking**: Automatically marks comics as read
- **Performance Optimized**: Parallel file operations and efficient memory management

## Development

This project was built using Flutter and follows Material Design 3 principles.

### Quick Start

```bash
# Install dependencies
flutter pub get

# Run the app
flutter run

# Build APK
flutter build apk
```

### Testing

```bash
# Run tests
flutter test

# Run static analysis
flutter analyze
```
